segments.text:
V. 9.
Will ye that I releaſe to you the king of the Jews—Which does this wretched Man diſcover moſt? Want of Juſtice, or Courage, or common Senſe? The poor C•ward ſacriſtees Juſtice to popular Clamour, and enrages thoſe whom he ſeeks to appeaſe, by ſo unſeaſonably repeating that Title, The king of the Jews, which he could not but know was ſo highly offenſive to them.
